title: ChartDB
name: chartdb
description: Database diagram editor that draws your real schema from one query's output, for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite, Oracle, ClickHouse and more, then lets you edit it and export it as SQL, even for a different database. Source: https://github.com/chartdb/chartdb

env.name: DISABLE_ANALYTICS
env.label: Analytics off
env.description: Keeps ChartDB's Fathom analytics script out of the page, so leave it as it is.

env.name: HIDE_CHARTDB_CLOUD
env.label: Hide the star-us popup
env.description: Stops the editor asking you to star the project on GitHub.

note: Open http://<your-host>:8087, pick your database, run the query it gives you against it, and paste the result back in to get the diagram (a SQL or DBML schema dump works too). There's no login and nothing to back up on the server, since diagrams are saved in your browser's own storage, so another browser or a cleared cache starts empty. Backup --> Export Diagram keeps a copy, and Restore Diagram brings it back. Actions --> Export SQL works offline, but its AI tab needs an OpenAI key, which ChartDB hands to every visitor, so it's left off here. The page loads its font from Google Fonts and a GitHub star button from ghbtns.com. Docs: docs.chartdb.io
